concerns.text: FR-011 (Post-hoc power analysis) is mapped to task T023, but T023 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). The spec requires estimating sample size for R²=0.10 with power ≥ 0.80; without this task, the requirement is unfulfilled.

FR-008 (Robustness: re-run with alternative params) and FR-009 (Sensitivity analysis) require robustness correlation and sensitivity analysis on the robustness dataset. Tasks T025d and T025e are marked incomplete (`- [ ]`), leaving these requirements unimplemented.

FR-005/FR-006/FR-012 results require schema validation per Constitution Principle IV. Task T035b (contract tests for model_results.json, etc.) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`), leaving the 'Single Source of Truth' verification unfulfilled.

Plan Phase 4 and Constitution Principle I require reproducible, runnable pipelines with verified tests. Tasks T033 (unit tests) and T036a (contract tests) are marked incomplete (`- [ ]`), preventing verification of the pipeline's executability and data hygiene.

Task T022 references shuffling on the 'held-out test set' for FR-007. While statistically valid, the spec FR-007 does not explicitly restrict the permutation scope to the test set. The task description should clarify if this is an optimization or a deviation to avoid ambiguity.

FR-008 requires robustness checks 'without ICA' and with 'alternative window length'. Tasks T025a (no ICA) and T025b (2s window) are separate. The tasks do not explicitly combine these conditions (no ICA + 2s window) to test the specific interaction required by the robustness scenario, nor do they ensure the 'no ICA' run uses the *same* window size as the primary analysis to isolate the ICA variable.
